opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Prioritize economy and technology over military production, aiming for a late-game advantage.
supporting_facts: The opening has a high support of 8527 games, indicating it is a common strategy.
The winrate is 48.5%, which is slightly below 50%, suggesting it is a balanced but not dominant opening.
The profile shows positive investments in economy (0.037) and technology (0.036), while investments in ground (0.0004) and air (0.0) are minimal, indicating a focus on economic and tech development.
The expansion investment is low (0.0035), suggesting a conservative expansion strategy.
The defense investment is very low (0.00009), indicating minimal early defensive structures.
